module: "driftThrough" stunt zone type (tight pass): the player must drift through an oriented box (OBB, center pos, half-axes derived from rot and scl) and come out of it. The module returns a constructor called by gameplay_drift_stuntZones.setStuntZones; it is not an extension. On success, emits onAnyStuntZoneAccomplished with the sub-hook onDriftThroughAccomplished (drift angle and driftThrough base points).
notes: The zone is validated on exiting the box: while the player is inside nothing happens; on the first "outside" reading usedFlag becomes true, then detectStunt calls accomplish. Details: isPlayerInside is only called when the player is drifting, so the exit is only detected if they are still drifting.
If no driftActiveData exists (imgui test), the angle sent is 30°.
Cooldown of zoneData.cooldown seconds after success. Drawing: two lines that change color (green ready, white/red during cooldown).

C.desc: driftThrough zone. Fields: data = {id, zoneData = {pos, scl (vec3), rot (quat), cooldown}, x, y, z (half-axes), drawData = {pointA..D}}, activeData = {isActive, currCooldown, usedFlag}.

init.desc: Internal constructor: stores the zone data and calls reset().

data.desc: {id, zoneData, x, y, z, drawData, nearDist}.

accomplish.desc: Success: resets usedFlag to false, starts the cooldown and emits onAnyStuntZoneAccomplished (sub-hook onDriftThroughAccomplished with currDegAngle and points).

detectStunt.desc: Called when the player drifts in the zone; calls accomplish if usedFlag is true.

isAvailable.desc: Returns whether the cooldown has elapsed.

returns.desc: true if the zone can be validated.

isPlayerInside.desc: Uses containsOBB_point to test whether the vehicle is in the box; if it is not, sets usedFlag to true.

returns.desc: true if the player is in the box.

onUpdate.desc: Called every frame by the manager: draws the lines.

sendDecals.desc: Draws the two edges of the zone with debugDrawer:drawLineInstance (if drawing is enabled).
